# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 renderer and refreshed package XML documentation. HarfBuzzSharp bindings now follow the bundled native source, with one renamed enum member and one removed aggregate flag.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed** — The misspelled CCC133 member is now CCC132, matching upstream HarfBuzz; its numeric value remains 132. Update source code that refers to CCC133. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **GlyphFlags.Defined was removed** — The aggregate flag mask is no longer exposed because it is not an independent option. Combine the concrete GlyphFlags values your application requires instead. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 154 and includes subsequent upstream browser and buffer-upload fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## Platform

- **Package XML documentation is available** — NuGet packages now carry compiler-generated XML documentation sidecars, with API documentation sourced from C# comments. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp bindings are now generated from the HarfBuzz source pinned by Skia, keeping supported managed declarations synchronized with version 14.2.1.
